bullets: Engineered an ML-based brake pad wear prediction model using telemetry and test-bench data, applying feature engineering and real-vehicle validation to achieve ~90% accuracy and reduce maintenance downtime by 25%.

Designed a temperature-weighted damage KPI reliability model by evaluating fatigue and mathematical techniques, improving axle joint assessment accuracy and cutting low-temperature validation testing by 33%.

Productized a time-series virtual sensor for maneuver detection by developing iterative detection logic and deploying a standalone EXE across departments, achieving >95% accuracy and significantly reducing manual validation effort.

Implemented a four-point Rainflow fatigue analytics pipeline to translate real-world vehicle load data into deployable damage metrics, enabling supplier-ready ECU feasibility for large-scale customer vehicle durability monitoring.
